name: Pendlay Row
instructions: Stand with your feet hip-width apart, hinge forward until your torso is parallel to the floor, and grip the barbell on the floor with a flat back.
Explosively row the bar up to your lower chest while keeping your torso still.
Lower the bar back to the floor and let it come to a full stop each rep.
Reset your back position before each rep and keep your spine neutral.
image_prompt_scene: Bent over with the torso parallel to the floor, the barbell on the floor and the arms extended.
